claims.text: Traditional methods for uncertainty quantification, such as probabilistic models and ensemble techniques, face challenges when applied to the complex and high-dimensional nature of LLM-generated outputs.
A novel geometric approach to uncertainty quantification using convex hull analysis is proposed.
The proposed method leverages the spatial properties of response embeddings to measure the dispersion and variability of model outputs.
